hub.headline: tri-Ace's PlayStation 2 renderer used spherical harmonic lighting and HDR rendering.
hub.next: Write a step-by-step reconstruction of the technique from the public presentation and notes.
hub.what_it_was: tri-Ace presented its PlayStation 2 techniques for spherical harmonic (SH) lighting and HDR rendering at GDC 2005. Later course notes by Yoshiharu Gotanda show the studio's rendering research continuing into physically based shading.
hub.what_survives: No source is public. tri-Ace's research site lists the GDC 2005 presentation, and the later course notes are public as a PDF.

name: tri-Ace PS2 renderer
summary: Public records now track tri-Ace's official PS2 SH/HDR presentation metadata and successor rendering course notes as public-reference-only lineage.
